evidence: naicslist.com directory lists the full registered address as 6620 Fillmore St, Hollywood, FL 33024, with NAICS code 238210 (Electrical Contractors) and about 3 employees.
The business's own Facebook page is tagged with location 'Hollywood, FL' (confirmed via a direct fetch of facebook.com/myelectricalgenie's page metadata/title before hitting the login wall).

bestprosintown.com lists the business under /fl/hollywood/my-electrical-genie-llc-/ (its URL path itself encodes Hollywood as the city), with reviews praising 'Marvin', the same name found in the Google reviews used on this site.

No source found ties the business to Pembroke Pines or Miramar as its registered location; those were only mentioned as possible nearby service-area context in the original task brief and were not corroborated by research.

The original Google Business Profile data pulled in an earlier pass already showed 'Hollywood, FL 33024, United States' as the city/zip (street hidden, typical of a service-area contractor listing), which matches the naicslist street address exactly on city and zip.

services_research_notes: No published price list or itemized service menu was found anywhere (consistent with has_own_site: false and no active Facebook content). Services shown on the site are grounded in: (1) bestprosintown.com's own category tags for the business (Electrician, Lighting Fixtures & Equipment, Home Automation), (2) the NAICS 238210 classification (Electrical Contractors and Other Wiring Installation Contractors), (3) verbatim review content describing real completed jobs (Paul M's review: generator transfer switch and inlet install ahead of hurricane season; Debra Matos's review: general office and home electrical issues), and (4) the two real downloaded photos showing a manual transfer switch/meter panel and an outdoor generator power inlet receptacle. No exact prices are shown anywhere on the site; CTA is 'Call for a quote' throughout, per the adapted-variant rule.
